description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [100% Critical], [Awoken Laguna Freak], [Damage Cap +10000], [Career Change Mode (Ice, Earth, Water)] and [Maximum Anchor Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Laguna Freak
description.text: Water, Ice and Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water, Ice and Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Career Change Mode (Ice, Earth, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Water] after using a Ice/Earth/Water ability

description.name: Maximum Anchor Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Maximum Anchor after using three Ice, Earth or Water abilities
